description:
We’re looking for a curious, self-driven Embedded Linux Engineer who thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. You'll join our fast-paced R&D team to design, build, and support high-performance embedded systems—ranging from real-time industrial devices to edge-IoT applications.

If you enjoy vibe coding with AI, thrive in an environment where learning is exponential, and want to take part in shaping high-tech products of the future—this role is for you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, test and maintain embedded Linux systems (Yocto, Nvidia Jetson, bootloader, device tree, BSPs)
  • Debug (or even develop) low-level drivers, peripheral interfaces, and middleware
  • Prototype and assemble electromechanical and electronic systems
  • Install and validate electrical subassemblies, control boards, and sensors
  • Integrate real-time OS / Linux-based firmware / modern microcontrollers / SoCs with protocols like ModBus, T1S Ethernet, PLC, Green PHY, UART and I2C
  • Collaborate in AI-assisted development workflows, leveraging coding copilots for rapid prototyping and exploration
  • Contribute to automation workflows, CI/CD for release testing and building
  • Participate in building experimental rigs, test benches, and automated diagnostics

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field
  • Solid experience with Embedded & Linux systems (Nvidia Jetson, Arduino, RPi, ESP32, STM32, RTOS, Zephyr, Micropython)
  • Proven work experience with C++ & Python in product development
  • Familiarity with shell scripting for code compilation, tooling and testing
  • Experience with device tree configuration, cross-compilation, and performance optimization
  • Understanding of hardware schematics, datasheets, and component-level debugging
  • Ability to work with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and serial debug tools
  • Comfortable with Git, YAML, collaborative workflows, and agile product development (we use Gitlab)

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive salary rate based on experience
  • MacBook Pro or custom Linux workstation
  • Access to professional labs, 3D printing, circuit design and rapid prototyping gear
  • Business trips to partner labs and international expos
  • Hybrid & flexible work schedule (for tasks that do not need hardware testing)
  • Transparent and supportive work culture
  • Opportunity to lead tech decisions and own projects end-to-end

The “Vibe Coding with AI” Mindset

We treat AI as an always-on pair-programmer: it drafts code/tests, explains datasheets, proposes optimisations and highlights security gaps. Your role is to steer the conversation, validate the output and turn rapid iterations into robust, production-ready software. This practice has been shown to cut feature lead-time in half while raising defect detection — an approach rapidly becoming standard across embedded teams in 2025.

Ready to Build the Future with us?

Send us your résumé + a short note describing a tricky bug you and an AI assistant solved together. Let’s vibe-code the next breakthrough device!
